DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 振込の控えについて、お調べしましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Shall I look into your transfer receipt?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 学校へ学費を振り込んだのですが、この控えに私の名前が見当たりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 学費振込の控えに自分の名前が見当たらないと相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: I transferred tuition to my school, but cannot find my name on this receipt.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about your name missing from the tuition transfer receipt. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 振込人の欄ですね。入力するときに、学校から何か指定はありましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: The remitter field, right? Did the school give instructions for entering it?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 学生番号を先に入れるように言われました。番号だけ入力してしまったかもしれません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 学生番号の入力指定と番号だけ入力した可能性を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: They said to put my student number first. I may have entered only the number.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain the student-number instruction and possibility you entered only that number. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 控えの振込人欄には番号だけが載っています。学校にはもう連絡されましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: Only a number appears in the receipt's remitter field. Have you contacted the school yet?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: まだです。振込をもう一度する前に、学校で私の支払いと分かるか確かめたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 再送金前に学校で支払いを識別できるか確認したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: Not yet. Before transferring again, I want to check whether the school can identify it as my payment.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you want to check whether the school can identify your payment before sending again. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 二重に送る前に確認されるとよいですね。振込の日時と金額はこの控えで伝えられます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Good to check before paying twice. You can give the transfer date, time and amount from this receipt.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 番号、日時、金額を学校へ知らせます。名前を後から付けられるかも知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 学校へ伝える情報を確認して振込人名の変更可否を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will tell the school the number, date, time and amount. I also want to know if my name can be added afterward.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Confirm the information to give the school and ask whether the remitter name can change. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 振込後の変更については担当者が取扱状況を調べます。すぐ変更できるとは限りません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: A staff member will check how changes after transfer are handled. It may not be possible immediately.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 変更できるかは調べてもらい、学校へは先に連絡します。控えの原本は持ち帰ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 変更調査を依頼し学校へ連絡して原本を保管すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: Please investigate whether it can change. I will contact the school first and take the original receipt home.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Request investigation of a change and say you will contact the school and preserve the original. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 原本はこちらへお返しします。担当者へおつなぎしますね、ご相談ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Here is your original back. I will connect you to the staff member. Thank you for consulting us.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お会計を止めました。どちらの金額が気になりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: I have paused checkout. Which amount concerns you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この惣菜に五十と書いてあるのに、半額になっていないように見えました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 割引シールの数字とレジ金額の違いを尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: This prepared dish says fifty, but it does not seem to be half price.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about the difference between the discount-sticker number and checkout amount. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: シールには五十円引きと書かれていますね。五十パーセント引きではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: The sticker says fifty yen off, rather than fifty percent off.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 円の文字を見落としていました。この表示額が五十円を引いた後の値段ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 円引きの読み違いを認め割引後の表示か確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: I missed the yen character. Is the displayed amount the price after fifty yen off?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Acknowledge misreading the yen discount and confirm whether the display is after discount. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: はい、元の価格と値引き額をこちらの画面で確認できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: Yes. You can check the original price and discount on this screen.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 分かりました。予算を超えるので、この惣菜だけ買うのをやめてもよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 予算を超えるため惣菜だけ購入を取りやめたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: I see. It exceeds my budget, so may I cancel just this prepared dish?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you want to cancel only the prepared dish because it exceeds your budget. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: お会計前ですから、こちらを外しますね。ほかの商品はそのままでよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: You have not paid yet, so I will remove it. Will you keep the other goods?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: ほかは買います。合計が変わったら、金額をもう一度教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: ほかの商品は購入して変更後の合計を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will buy the others. Please tell me the amount again once the total changes.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Buy the other goods and ask for the revised total. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 惣菜を外した合計を表示しました。こちらの金額でお会計します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: The total excluding the dish is displayed. We will charge this amount.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: この金額なら大丈夫です。表示を確認できたので、支払います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 変更後の合計が予算内だと確認して支払う。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: This amount is fine. I checked the display and will pay.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm the revised total is within budget and pay. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ありがとうございました。またのご来店をお待ちしております。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you. We look forward to your next visit.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 何かお探しですか。入口のほうを見ていらっしゃいましたね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you looking for something? You were looking toward the entrance.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 散歩の途中で帽子がなくなりました。ここに届いていないか聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 散歩中になくした帽子の届出有無を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: My hat went missing during my walk. I want to ask whether it has been handed in here.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether a hat lost during your walk has been handed in. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 今お預かりしている帽子はありません。最後にかぶっていた場所は覚えていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: We have no hats in our care now. Do you remember where you last wore it?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 池の近くのベンチで休んだときは、まだかぶっていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 最後に帽子をかぶっていたベンチの位置を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: I still had it on when resting on the bench near the pond.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain the location of the bench where you last wore the hat. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: ベンチからこちらへは、どの道を通りましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: Which path did you take here from the bench?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 花壇を回って来ました。ただ、風で植え込みに入ったかもしれません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 通った道と風で植え込みへ入った可能性を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: I came around the flowerbeds. But the wind may have blown it into the bushes.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Give your route and the possibility wind blew the hat into bushes. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 植え込みには入らず、通路から見える範囲を探してください。届いた場合に見分けられるよう、色も教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Do not enter the bushes; search what is visible from the path. Tell me its color so we can identify it if handed in.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 紺色で、後ろに白いひもが付いています。植え込みの奥を調べたい場合は係の方に頼みます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 帽子の特徴を説明し植え込みには入らず係員へ頼むと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: Navy blue, with a white cord at the back. If I want deeper bushes checked, I will ask staff.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Describe the hat and say you will ask staff rather than enter bushes. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: その特徴を記録しますね。見える所になければ、探した場所をこちらへ知らせてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: I will record those details. If it is not visible, tell us where you searched.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: まずベンチまで同じ道を戻ります。見つからなければ、花壇側を探したことも伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 同じ経路を戻り見つからない場合の報告範囲を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: First I will retrace the same path to the bench. If I do not find it, I will also report searching by the flowerbeds.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will retrace your route and report the search area if unsuccessful. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 通路の足元に気をつけてお探しください。お話しくださってありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33210-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Watch your footing on the path as you search. Thank you for telling us.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 時刻表をご覧ですね。探している列車がありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: You are looking at the timetable. Is there a train you want?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 保存した画像には九時十分とありますが、掲示では見つかりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 保存画像と掲示で出発時刻が違うと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: My saved image says 9:10, but I cannot find that on the posted board.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say the departure time differs between your saved image and the posted board. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 画像の上部に、曜日の区分や更新日が書かれていませんか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: Does the top of the image show a day category or update date?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 上には「土曜・休日」とあります。今日は平日なので、別の欄を見るのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 休日用画像だと気づき平日欄を見ると確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: It says “Saturdays and holidays.” Today is a weekday, so I should look in another column.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Realize the image is for holidays and confirm using the weekday column. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: はい。こちらの平日欄で、行き先と出発時刻を一緒に確かめましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: Yes. Let us check the destination and departure time together in this weekday column.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: この列車に乗りたいです。反対方向の欄を見ていないか確認してもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 選んだ列車の方向が正しいか駅員に確認を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: I want this train. Could you check I am not looking at the opposite-direction column?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask station staff to confirm your selected train's direction is correct. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 今見ている欄は、その行き先の方向です。次に乗り場の表示を確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: The column you are viewing is for that destination's direction. Next check the platform display.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 乗り場が変更されたときは、時刻表より電光掲示を確認したほうがいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 乗り場変更時に確認する表示を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: If the platform changes, should I check the electronic board rather than the timetable?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask which display to check when the platform changes. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 変更の案内と放送にも注意してください。食い違う場合は駅員にお尋ねください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: Watch change notices and listen to announcements too. Ask station staff if they conflict.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 画像だけで決めず、今日の曜日と行き先を掲示で照合してから乗ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 当日の曜日と行き先を掲示で照合して乗ると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will not rely on the image alone, but compare today's day and my destination with the board before boarding.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will match today's day and destination against the board before boarding. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: その確認でお願いします。どうぞお気をつけて、行ってらっしゃい。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please do that. Take care and have a good trip.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 申請書の記入で、確認したい箇所はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is there a part of the application you want to check?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 世帯主の欄に自分の名前を書きました。でも、同居している兄が世帯主かもしれません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 自分を世帯主と記入したが兄の可能性があると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: I wrote my name as household head. But my older brother living with me may be the head.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you entered yourself as household head but it may be your older brother. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 思い込みで書かず、登録上の世帯主を確認しましょう。ご本人確認の書類はお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let us check the registered household head instead of assuming. Do you have identification?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 持っています。この欄は部屋の契約者を書く欄とは違うのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 本人確認書類を持参し契約者欄との違いを確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes. This field is different from the one for the room's contract holder, right?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you brought identification and confirm the difference from the contract-holder field. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: はい。住宅の契約者と、住民登録上の世帯主は必ずしも同じではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Yes. The housing contract holder and registered household head are not necessarily the same.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 確認が終わるまで、その欄の訂正は待ったほうがいいでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 世帯主の確認が終わるまで訂正を待つべきか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: Should I wait to correct that field until the check is finished?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask whether to wait for household-head confirmation before correcting. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: ほかの記入を進めながら確認できます。間違えた箇所の訂正方法もご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: We can check while you fill other parts. We will explain how to correct the mistake too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 名前を上から重ねず、窓口で教わった方法で訂正したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 上書きせず案内された訂正方法で直したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: I want to correct it by the method taught at the counter, without writing over the name.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you want to use the instructed correction method rather than overwrite. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: では先に記載内容を確認します。提出前にこちらへ申請書をお戻しください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Then we will check the entries first. Return the application here before submitting.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 必要な確認をしてから訂正し、提出前にもう一度見ていただきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 確認後に訂正し提出前の再確認を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will make the necessary checks, correct it, then have you look again before submission.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will correct after checking and request another check before submission. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。いったん記入台へどうぞ、ご協力ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Please go back to the writing desk for now. Thank you for your cooperation.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 服用中の薬の欄が空いていますね。今、お薬を飲んでいますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: The current-medicines field is blank. Are you taking any medicine now?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 毎晩一錠飲んでいますが、名前を覚えていません。薬袋の写真ならあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 毎晩一錠服用し薬名不明だが薬袋写真があると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: One tablet every night, but I do not remember its name. I have a photo of the medicine bag.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you take one tablet nightly, do not know its name and have a medicine-bag photo. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 写真の文字を一緒に確認しましょう。処方された時期も分かりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let us check the photo's text together. Do you know when it was prescribed?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 二週間前です。写真の名前がぼやけているので、推測で書きたくありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 二週間前の処方と写真不鮮明を伝え推測記入を避ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: Two weeks ago. The name is blurry in the photo, so I do not want to write a guess.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Give the prescription two weeks ago and blurry photo, and avoid guessing the entry. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 名前が確認できないことを記入し、写真があることも医師に伝えましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Write that the name cannot be confirmed and tell the doctor you have a photo too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 「薬名不明、毎晩一錠」と書いて、写真を診察で見せます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 薬名不明と服用頻度を記入し診察で写真を見せると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will write “medicine name unknown, one tablet nightly” and show the photo at the consultation.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you will write the unknown name and frequency and show the photo at the consultation. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい。お薬手帳や現物があれば、確認に役立つこともあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Yes. A medication record book or the actual medicine may also help confirm it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 今日は手帳を家に置いてきました。家族に写真を送ってもらうよう頼んでもいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 手帳を忘れ家族へ写真の送付を頼めるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: I left the book at home today. May I ask my family to send a photo?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you forgot the record book and ask whether family can send a photo. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 頼めるのであればお願いしてください。届くまでに診察になったら、未確認だと伝えましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please ask if you can. If your consultation comes before it arrives, say it remains unconfirmed.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 薬の名前を決めつけず、まず医師に未確認のままだと説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 薬名を決めつけず未確認として医師に説明すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will not assume the medicine name, but first explain to the doctor that it is still unconfirmed.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will explain the unconfirmed medicine name to the doctor without assuming. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: その点を申し送りしておきます。では待合室でお待ちください、お大事になさってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will pass that information on. Please wait in the waiting room. Take care.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 届いた連絡についてのご相談ですね。今、相手が近くにいる状況ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: You want advice about a message received. Is the other person nearby now?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 相手はここにはいません。注文していない荷物の代金を今日中に払うよう、メッセージが来ました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 相手が近くにおらず未注文荷物の支払い要求を受けたと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: They are not here. A message demands payment today for a parcel I did not order.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say the person is not nearby and you received a payment demand for an unordered parcel. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: メッセージの日時と内容を確認します。記載された番号に電話しましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: We will check the message date, time and content. Did you call the listed number?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 電話はしていません。届いた時刻が分かる画面を保存しました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 電話未発信で受信時刻付き画面を保存したと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: I have not called. I saved the screen showing when it arrived.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain you made no call and saved the screen with receipt time. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: その記録を見せてください。リンクを開いたり、支払い情報を入力したりしましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Show that record. Did you open a link or enter payment information?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: リンクも開いていません。ただ、昨日知らない番号から着信があったので、関係があるか気になります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: リンク未開封と前日の不明着信を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: I did not open the link either. But an unknown number called yesterday, and I wonder whether it is related.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you did not open the link and received an unknown call the previous day. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 関連はまだ分かりません。着信の記録も合わせて確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: We do not know the connection yet. Let us check the incoming-call record too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 二つの記録を別々に見せます。相手に返信して注文内容を聞くのは控えたほうがいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 別々の記録を示し注文内容を返信で尋ねるべきか相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will show the two records separately. Should I avoid replying to ask for order details?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Show separate records and ask whether you should inquire about the order by replying. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 今ここでは返信せず、まず内容を確認しましょう。身に覚えのない要求には慎重に対応してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Do not reply here now; let us check the content first. Be careful with demands you do not recognize.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 返信をせず、メッセージと着信の日時を整理して説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 返信せず受信と着信の日時を整理して説明すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will not reply, and will organize and explain the message and incoming-call dates and times.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will explain organized receipt and call dates and times without replying. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: お話を伺いました。追加の記録があればまたご相談ください、お気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: We have heard your account. Consult us again if you have further records. Have a safe trip home.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 箱を動かすと、中で物が動く音がしますね。何を入れていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Something rattles inside when the box moves. What is in it?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 本を三冊入れました。箱の隙間が大きいまま持ってきてしまいました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 三冊の本を隙間の大きい箱に入れたと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: Three books. I brought it with a lot of empty space still inside.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain packing three books in a box with large gaps. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 発送前に中身が動きにくいよう、梱包を見直すとよさそうです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: It would be good to repack before shipping so the contents move less.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: いったん持ち帰って、隙間に紙を詰めてから持ってきてもいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 持ち帰り隙間を埋めて再持参できるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: May I take it home, fill the gaps with paper and bring it again?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask whether you can take it home, fill gaps and bring it again. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: はい。箱の強度と閉じ方も確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Yes. Check the box's strength and how it closes too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 本の角が箱に直接当たっているので、角も保護して包み直します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 本の角を保護して梱包し直すと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: The book corners touch the box directly, so I will protect them and repack.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you will protect the book corners and repack. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 包み直したら、外側の宛名が読める状態かも確かめましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: After repacking, check that the address on the outside is readable too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 今の宛名ラベルを剥がして、新しい箱に貼り直すときの注意はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 新しい箱への宛名ラベル貼り直しの注意を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: Any precautions when peeling off the current address label and reattaching it to a new box?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask precautions for reattaching the address label to a new box. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 古いラベルが残らないようにし、送り先の文字をつぶさず貼ってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Leave no old labels and attach it without obscuring the destination lettering.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 宛名を新しく書き、本が動かない箱にしてから改めて持参します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 宛名を新しく書き本が動かない梱包で再持参すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will write a new address label and bring it again in a box where the books cannot move.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will write a new address label and return with packing that keeps books still. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 本日はまだお預かりしません。準備ができましたらお越しください、ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: We will not accept it today yet. Come when ready. Thank you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 通帳をお持ちですね。どの箇所を確認しましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: You have your passbook. Which part shall we check?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この一行だけ印字が薄くて、入金額が三千円か八千円か読めません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 通帳の薄い一行の入金額が読めないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: Just this line is faint, and I cannot tell whether the deposit is three thousand or eight thousand yen.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you cannot read the deposit amount in a faint passbook line. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: ここですね。金額を推測せず、口座の記録と照合しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: This part, right? Let us compare account records without guessing the amount.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 照合をお願いしたいです。日付は読めるので、この日の取引です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 読める取引日を示して口座記録との照合を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: Please compare them. I can read the date, so it is the transaction on this day.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show the readable transaction date and request comparison with account records. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 確認に必要な本人確認を先に行います。確認書類を出していただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: First we need to verify your identity for the check. Could you present identification?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: こちらを使えますか。名前と住所が載っている書類です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 氏名住所記載の本人確認書類を使えるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: Can I use this? It shows my name and address.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask whether identification showing your name and address is acceptable. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 利用できる書類か確認します。金額を確かめた後、通帳の状態も見ますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: I will check whether it is accepted. After confirming the amount, I will examine the passbook's condition too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 薄い文字を自分でペンでなぞるのは、やめておいたほうがいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 薄い文字をペンでなぞるべきでないか確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: Should I avoid tracing the faint characters with a pen myself?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Check whether you should avoid tracing the faint text with a pen. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 書き加えずにそのままお預けください。対応できる方法を確認してご説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Give it to us as it is without adding anything. We will check and explain available options.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: では何も書き足さず、記録の照合と通帳の対応方法を待ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 書き足さず記録照合と対応方法の案内を待つと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: Then I will add nothing and wait for the record comparison and advice on handling the passbook.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will add nothing and wait for record comparison and available options. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: いったんお席でお待ちください。確認後にお呼びしますので、では後ほど。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please wait in a seat for now. We will call after checking. See you shortly.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 画面の金額で、気になる商品がありましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Was there an item whose screen price concerned you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この弁当は値引きだと思って選びましたが、画面では通常の金額です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 値引きと思った弁当が通常金額で表示されたと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: I chose this boxed meal thinking it was discounted, but the screen shows the regular price.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say a boxed meal you thought discounted appeared at the regular price. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 貼られているシールを確認しますね。お客様が見た表示はどこでしたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let me check its sticker. Where was the display you saw?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 隣の弁当には黄色いシールがあったので、同じ棚の商品全部が対象だと思いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 隣の商品シールを棚全体の値引きと誤解したと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: The neighboring meal had a yellow sticker, so I thought all items on that shelf were included.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain mistaking a neighboring item's sticker for a shelf-wide discount. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: こちらの弁当には値引きシールがありません。隣の商品とは表示が違うようです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: This meal has no discount sticker. Its labeling differs from the neighboring item.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 私の見間違いですね。会計を終える前なので、この弁当だけ取りやめられますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 見間違いを認め会計前に弁当だけ取消できるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: I misread it. Since checkout is not finished, can I cancel just this meal?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Acknowledge misreading and ask to cancel just the meal before checkout ends. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 取りやめの操作をします。ほかの商品はそのままでよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: I will cancel it. Will you keep the other goods?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 牛乳とパンは買います。弁当を外した後の合計を見せてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 牛乳とパンを購入し取消後の合計表示を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will buy the milk and bread. Show me the total after removing the meal.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Buy the milk and bread and request the total after cancellation. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: この金額が弁当を外した合計です。商品も二点になっています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: This is the total without the meal. There are now two items too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 二点と合計を確認できました。この金額を現金で払います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 二点と合計を確認し現金支払いを伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I checked the two items and total. I will pay this amount in cash.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm the two items and total and say you will pay cash. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: お会計ありがとうございました。レシートをお持ちになり、お気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33211-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you for your payment. Please take your receipt and have a safe trip home.
